cues: Every mixed ether can be cut two ways, and only one way works.
Take M T B E, two methoxy two methylpropane.
Route one: the bulky tertiary group as the alkoxide, and iodomethane as the halide.
The methyl carbon is wide open at the back, so S N two goes smoothly.
